description: Source code for the Kubernetes image volume plugin, implementing the volume plugin interface with stub methods for image volume support.

classes.name: imagePlugin
classes.description: Implements the volume plugin interface for image volumes, acting as a stub with minimal functionality.

methods.name: ProbeVolumePlugins
methods.description: Returns a list containing an instance of the imagePlugin.

methods.name: GetVolumeName
methods.description: Retrieves the volume name from the volume spec, referencing the ImageVolumeSource.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if the spec supports image volumes.

methods.name: NewMounter
methods.description: Returns the plugin itself as a mounter.

methods.name: NewUnmounter
methods.description: Returns the plugin itself as an unmounter.

methods.name: ConstructVolumeSpec
methods.description: Constructs a volume specification, returns an empty volume.

methods.name: GetAttributes
methods.description: Returns volume attributes such as read-only and management status.

methods.name: GetPath
methods.description: Returns an empty string as path.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Stub method for setting up the volume.

methods.name: SetUpAt
methods.description: Stub method for setting up the volume at a specific path.

methods.name: SupportsMountOption
methods.description: Indicates mount options are not supported.

methods.name: SupportsSELinuxContextMount
methods.description: Indicates SELinux context mount is not supported.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Stub method for tearing down the volume.

methods.name: TearDownAt
methods.description: Stub method for tearing down the volume at a specific path.
